study type: Prospective Cohort Study with Survival Analysis
exposure: Ambient temperature (weekly mean, daytime, night-time, variability)
cohort: The study included 5347 live singleton births from three prospective cohorts in France between 2002 and 2018.
finding: Chronic and acute cold exposures, as well as night-time heat, were associated with an increased risk of preterm birth in a temperate climate.
